info.title: ControlHome API
info.description: Same-origin API of the ControlHome web app. Mutating requests must send an Origin header equal to the app's origin and the header 'X-ControlHome: 1'. Errors are RFC 7807 ProblemDetails with a stable 'code'.

get.summary: First-run state; answers even while the database is not ready.

post.summary: Pre-database setup: tests the SQL Server connection, saves it (encrypted) and starts the database initialization.
post.description: Only while no database connection is configured (else 409 db.already_configured); answers even while the database is not ready. 400: validation.failed, setup.invalid_code, db.connection_failed (extension reason), sql.version_unsupported or sql.compatibility_unsupported; 409: db.create_denied (extension script: T-SQL for an administrator) or db.already_configured. 202: saved; poll GET /api/setup/status until databaseState is Ready.

post.summary: Creates the first Admin and the home, then signs the admin in.
Signs in with user name and password (sets the session cookie).
Sets a new password with a one-time token from 'reset-admin <user>'.
Confirms the safety PIN: allows one safety-critical command (unlock, open the gate, disarm) within 60 s.
post.description: 409 safety.pin_not_set; 400 safety.pin_incorrect; 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds) after 5 wrong PINs within 15 minutes, which also blocks safety-critical commands for 15 minutes.

put.summary: Changes the signed-in user's display name, language and theme.

get.summary: Whether the signed-in user has a safety PIN, and any lockout.

put.summary: Sets the safety PIN (4–8 digits) for safety-critical commands, or changes it (currentPin required).
put.description: 400 validation.failed or safety.pin_incorrect (wrong currentPin; counts as a failed attempt); 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds) after 5 wrong PINs within 15 minutes.

put.summary: Changes display name, role or disabled state (the last active Admin is protected).

delete.summary: Deletes the account (never yourself, never the last active Admin).

post.summary: Sets a new password for the account.

get.summary: Audit entries, newest first; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

post.summary: Creates an empty floor (default size 2000 × 1500 cm, grid 50 cm).

put.summary: Changes name, level, size, grid and background.
put.description: 409 floors.concurrency when rowVersion is not the floor's current one (reload it). 400 validation.failed, also when the new size would cut a room (errors.widthCm / errors.heightCm = geometry.out_of_bounds) or the background file does not exist (errors['background.fileId'] = files.not_found).

delete.summary: Deletes the floor and its rooms.

put.summary: Replaces the floor's rooms atomically (rooms not listed are deleted).
put.description: 409 floors.concurrency when rowVersion is not the floor's current one (reload it). 400 validation.failed with field errors; geometry problems are codes under rooms[i].polygon: geometry.too_few_points, geometry.too_many_points, geometry.out_of_bounds, geometry.zero_area, geometry.self_intersecting; rooms[i].id = rooms.not_found for a room that is not on this floor.

get.summary: All rooms of all floors, by floor level and room order.

post.summary: Uploads an image (multipart: file, purpose=floor-background); it is stored re-encoded as WebP.
post.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP (recognized by content, not name), at most 10 MB and 40 megapixels; the stored image is WebP, at most 4096 px on its longest side, without metadata. 400: files.unsupported_type, files.too_large, files.invalid_image, or validation.failed (unknown purpose); 413 request.too_large for requests over 16 MB.

get.summary: The file's bytes (cacheable for a year: files never change).
Every capability definition: attributes (schemas, units, state classes) and commands (arguments, safety flags).
Devices with their endpoints, capabilities, attribute ids and current values, by name.
get.description: Filters (all optional, combined): roomId, integrationId, capability (e.g. switch), q (name, manufacturer or model).

parameters.name: RoomId
parameters.description: Devices with at least one endpoint in the room (an endpoint's own room, else the device's).

parameters.name: Capability
parameters.description: Devices with an endpoint that has this (non-retired) capability, e.g. `switch`.

parameters.name: Q
parameters.description: Text contained in the name, manufacturer or model.

get.summary: A device with its vendor details, endpoints and child devices.

put.summary: Renames a device and sets its icon and room.
put.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.roomId = rooms.not_found for an unknown room); 404 devices.not_found.

put.summary: Changes an endpoint's name, icon, room and hidden flag.
put.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.roomId = rooms.not_found for an unknown room); 404 endpoints.not_found.

put.summary: Adds the endpoint to the dashboard's favorites, or removes it.

post.summary: Sends a command to an endpoint; progress arrives as hub CommandStatus messages.
post.description: 202 with the command id. 400 commands.unsupported (no such capability or command on this endpoint) or commands.invalid_arguments (errors['arguments.<key>'] = commands.argument_*); 403 safety.step_up_required (safety-critical: POST /api/auth/step-up first, then resend with the same idempotencyKey) or safety.not_allowed; 404 endpoints.not_found; 409 commands.duplicate (idempotency key already used) or commands.gate_closed; 423 safety.locked (retryAfterSeconds); 503 commands.unavailable (integration not running).

get.summary: Every attribute's current value (resync after a hub reconnect).
The connectors of this build (descriptors: names, icon, config forms, features).
All integrations with their status and device count, by name.

post.summary: Creates an integration from a connector key and its config; its runtime starts right away.
post.description: 400 validation.failed (errors.connectorKey = connectors.not_found for an unknown connector) or integrations.invalid_config (errors['config.<key>'] = commands.argument_* codes). Secret config fields are stored encrypted and never returned.

delete.summary: Stops the integration and deletes it with all its devices and their state.

get.summary: Runtime mode (Starting, Active, Standby), whether history is paused, and the app version.

attribute.description: The attribute it sets (its constraints apply), if any.

ArgumentDefinitionDto.description: An argument of a command (a member of the command's `arguments` object).

schema.description: The value's shape (discriminator `type`: bool, number, enum, string, flags, json, momentary).

recorded.description: Whether changes are kept in the history.

writable.description: Whether a command of the capability changes it.

attributeId.description: The key of every state, history and hub delta for this attribute.

value.description: The current value; `{kind:'null'}` when none was reported yet.

observedAtUtc.description: When the value was observed, or `null` when none was reported yet.

lastChangedAtUtc.description: When the value last changed, or `null`.

restored.description: Loaded from the database and not yet confirmed by the running connector.

AttributeDto.description: One attribute and its current value.

restored.description: Loaded from the database and not yet confirmed by the running connector.

AttributeStateDto.description: The current value of one attribute (`GET /api/state` resync, and the source of AttributeDto).

detailsJson.description: Optional JSON object with action details.

AuditEntryDto.description: One audit log entry, newest first in listings.

AvailabilityChangedDto.description: A device became reachable or not (hub `AvailabilityChanged`).

CapabilityDto.description: A capability definition as served by `GET /api/capabilities` (and inside generic endpoint capabilities).

CommandAcceptedDto.description: The command was accepted; its progress arrives as hub `CommandStatus` messages with this id.

timeoutMs.description: Confirmation timeout; `null` uses the connector's default.

safetyCritical.description: Always needs a step-up PIN (unlock, door opener, disarm).

safetyCriticalForDeviceClasses.description: Device classes on which it needs a step-up PIN too (cover open on gate/garage).

failSafe.description: The safe direction (lock, close): never gated.

gateAttribute.description: A boolean attribute that must be true for the command to be accepted, if any.

capabilityId.description: A capability of the endpoint, e.g. `switch`.

command.description: A command of that capability, e.g. `turnOn` or `setLevel`.

oneOf.description: The arguments object (e.g. `{"level": 40}`); omit or `null` for none.

idempotencyKey.description:
Unique per user action (1–128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -`; a UUID is fine). The same key again within 10 minutes is
refused with 409 `commands.duplicate` and never reaches the device (at-most-once). Send the same key when retrying
the same action (e.g. after a step-up). The server generates one when omitted.

commandId.description: The id from the command's 202 response.

status.description:
`pending` (accepted, not done yet), then one final status: `confirmed`, `failed`, `timed_out` or
        `superseded` (a later command for the same control replaced it before it was sent).

code.description: For `failed` and `timed_out`: an error code (`commands.*`), translated as `errors.<code>`.

CommandStatusDto.description: Progress of a command sent with `POST /api/endpoints/{id}/commands` (hub `CommandStatus`).

setupCode.description: The one-time setup code from the server log or `setup-code.txt` (dashes/spaces ignored).

CompleteSetupRequest.description: Completes the first-run setup: creates the first Admin and the home, then signs the admin in.

key.description: Stable id, e.g. `simulated`; used as `connectorKey` when creating an integration.

icon.description: Icon key (lucide name, or a prefixed key such as `mdi:…`).

configFields.description: The integration's configuration form (rendered with the shared schema form).

deviceConfigFields.description: Per-device settings, usually secret; empty when none.

ConnectorDto.description: A connector in the integrations catalogue (`GET /api/connectors`).

setupFlow.description: Setup runs through a flow (milestone 1.3); otherwise integrations are created from the config fields.

CreateFloorRequest.description: Creates an empty floor (Admin). Size defaults to 2000 × 1500 cm, grid 50 cm.

oneOf.description: The config object (members per the connector's config fields); secret fields are stored encrypted and never returned.

CreateIntegrationRequest.description: Creates an integration from a connector's config fields (`POST /api/integrations`; no setup flow in 1.2).

host.description: Host name or IP address of the SQL Server, as the ControlHome server (container) resolves it.

database.description: The application database; created by ControlHome when the login may create databases.

DatabaseSetupRequest.description:
Pre-database setup: the SQL Server connection to test and save. Accepted only while no connection is configured.
The connection always uses TLS (`Encrypt=True`); TrustServerCertificate accepts the server's
own (usually self-signed) certificate.

DeviceChildDto.description: A child device of a DeviceDetailDto.

externalId.description: The connector's id for the device.

children.description: Devices reached through this one (e.g. an NVR's cameras), by name.

DeviceDetailDto.description: A device with its vendor details (`GET /api/devices/{id}`).

parentDeviceId.description: The device it is reached through (an NVR for a camera), if any.

isOrphaned.description: No longer reported by its integration (kept, shown with a badge).

DeviceSummaryDto.description: A device in the device list, with its endpoints, capabilities, attribute ids and current values.

retired.description: No longer reported by the connector: hide its controls (history is kept).

oneOf.description: The endpoint's narrowing (ranges, enum subsets) as a constraints object, or `null`.

attributes.description: The attributes known so far (ordered by key).

EndpointCapabilityDto.description: A capability of an endpoint with its constraints and attributes.

key.description: The connector's key (`main` for single-endpoint devices).

name.description: The user's name, or `null` to show the device name.

roomId.description: The endpoint's own room, or `null` to inherit the device's.

effectiveRoomId.description: The room the endpoint is in: its own, else the device's.

hidden.description: Left out of dashboards and pickers.

EndpointDto.description: A controllable part of a device (commands address endpoints).

key.description: camelCase member name of the submitted `config` object.

FloorBackgroundDto.description:
The image under a floor plan: its top-left corner sits at (OffsetXCm, OffsetYCm)
and one image pixel measures CmPerPx centimetres.

widthCm.description: Plan width (the SVG viewBox is `0 0 WidthCm HeightCm`).

rowVersion.description: Opaque concurrency token; a change sent with an older one gets 409 `floors.concurrency`.

FloorDto.description: A floor with its rooms. Send RowVersion back with every change to it.

FloorSummaryDto.description: A floor in the floor list.

pricePerKwh.description: Flat electricity price per kWh (tariff kind `flat`), if known.
Flat electricity price per kWh, if known.

code.description: Stable, dotted error code (e.g. auth.invalid_credentials); the UI translates errors.<code>.

traceId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

statusMessage.description: A short non-secret explanation of the status, if any.

IntegrationDto.description: An integration in the integrations list.

message.description: A short non-secret explanation, if any.

LocalizedTextDto.description: A text in both UI languages.

rememberMe.description: Keep the session cookie across browser restarts (30-day sliding expiration).

PagedResultOfAuditEntryDto.description: A page of items; pass NextCursor back as `cursor` to get the next page (null = last page).

PointCmDto.description: A point on a floor plan in centimetres (origin: the floor's top-left corner; y grows downwards).

code.description: Stable, dotted error code (e.g. auth.invalid_credentials); the UI translates errors.<code>.

traceId.description: Correlates the response with the server log.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: An Admin sets a new password for another user.

ResetPasswordWithTokenRequest.description: Consumes a one-time reset token printed by the `reset-admin` command.

polygon.description: The outline (implicitly closed), in the floor's centimetre coordinates.

areaM2.description: Enclosed area in m², rounded to two decimals.

id.description: An existing room of this floor, or `null` for a new room.

polygon.description:
At least 3 points, simple (no self-intersection), inside the floor and enclosing an area; violations are field errors
under `rooms[i].polygon` with codes `geometry.*`.

RoomInput.description: A room in a layout save.

RoomListItemDto.description: A room in the list of all rooms (for pickers).

isSet.description: Whether the user has a PIN (changing it then needs the current one).

lockedForSeconds.description: Seconds left of a lockout after too many wrong PINs, or `null`.

SafetyPinStatusDto.description: The signed-in user's safety PIN state (`GET /api/auth/me/pin`).

SaveFloorLayoutRequest.description:
Replaces the floor's rooms atomically (Admin): listed rooms with an `id` are updated, rooms without one are
created, rooms not listed are deleted; the list order becomes the display order.

SetFavoriteRequest.description: Adds an endpoint to (or removes it from) the dashboard's favorites (`PUT /api/endpoints/{id}/favorite`, Member).

currentPin.description: The PIN in use; required when one is set.

SetPinRequest.description: Sets or changes the signed-in user's safety PIN (`PUT /api/auth/me/pin`).

databaseConfigured.description: Whether a database connection is configured (either source).

databaseSource.description:
Where the connection comes from: `environment` (`ConnectionStrings__ControlHome`), `file` (saved by the
setup wizard) or `none` (pre-database setup mode: `POST /api/setup/database`).

databaseError.description: While DatabaseState is `Failed`: the error code, e.g. `db.connection_failed`.

SetupStatusDto.description: First-run state. Answered even while the database is not ready (then SetupCompleted is false).

StateDelta.description: A new current value of one attribute (hub `StateChanged`).

b.description: Set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Bool.

n.description: Set (finite) when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Number.

s.description: Set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.String.

j.description: A JSON object or array, set when StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is StateValueKind.Json.

StateValue.description:
An attribute value as it travels in DTOs and hub messages: `{ kind: 'bool'|'number'|'string'|'json'|'null', b?, n?,
s?, j? }` — exactly the member named by StateValueKind StateValue.Kind is set. Create values with the factories
(StateValue StateValue.Bool(bool value), StateValue StateValue.Number(double value), StateValue StateValue.String(string value), StateValue StateValue.Json(JsonElement value), StateValue StateValue.Null,
StateValue StateValue.FromJson(JsonElement value)); equality compares JSON values structurally.

StateValueKind.description: Which member of a StateValue holds the value (stored as `tinyint`).

StepUpRequest.description: Proves the PIN before a safety-critical command (`POST /api/auth/step-up`).

contentType.description: Always `image/webp` for images (they are re-encoded on upload).

StoredFileDto.description: A stored file. Its bytes are at `GET /api/files/{id}` (immutable: a new upload gets a new id).

runtimeMode.description: `Starting`, `Active` or `Standby` (show a banner when not Active).

historyPaused.description:
The database could not keep up (or is down) and state history was dropped; current state and control keep working.
Cleared once the backlog is written.

icon.description: An icon key (lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `:`), or `null` for the class's default.

UpdateDeviceRequest.description: Renames a device, sets its icon and room (`PUT /api/devices/{id}`, Admin).

name.description: The endpoint's own name, or `null` to show the device's.

roomId.description: The endpoint's own room, or `null` to inherit the device's.

hidden.description: Leave it out of dashboards and pickers.

oneOf.description: The background image, or `null` to remove it.

UpdateFloorRequest.description:
Changes a floor's properties (Admin); rooms are kept. The size cannot shrink below a room (400 with
`errors.widthCm`/`errors.heightCm` = `geometry.out_of_bounds`).

UserDto.description: A household account as seen by an Admin.

ValueSchema.description:
The shape of one value: an attribute's state, a command argument or a connector configuration field. A closed set of
records serialized polymorphically with the discriminator `type` (`bool`, `number`, `enum`,
`string`, `flags`, `json`, `momentary`); the web app renders every schema-driven control from it.

values.description: The allowed values, in display order; never empty.

ValueSchemaEnumSchema.description: One of a fixed list of string values (an endpoint's constraints may allow only a subset).

ValueSchemaFlagsSchema.description: A set of named flags (a bitmap), as a JSON array of distinct flag names.

ValueSchemaJsonValueSchema.description: Any JSON value (read-only data such as a vendor's raw structure).

events.description: The event names this attribute emits (e.g. `single`, `double`, `long`); empty means any.

ValueSchemaMomentarySchema.description:
An event without lasting state (a button press, a doorbell ring). A momentary attribute is updated only through
connector events (`IConnectorContext.ReportEvent`): its value is the last event name and its observed time is when
that event happened.

step.description: Granularity: valid values are `(Min ?? 0) + k × Step`.

maxLength.description: Maximum length in UTF-16 code units, if any.
